children: Tourmaline will sell 10M Topaz shares for ~$287.5M and use proceeds to repurchase its own shares under its NCIB. The board approved a 5% increase in the quarterly base dividend to $0.525/share effective Q4 2026.
Unlocks cash without new debt; signals rotation into perceived undervalued TOU shares.
Could raise additional cash; adds near-term TPZ supply pressure.
Buybacks can support EPS and share price if executed at lows.
5% hike signals confidence in cash flow durability.
Reduces cross-holding; potential overhang on TPZ lessens after deal.

This is a late-cycle capital return move, reallocating from a non-core holding to buybacks while modestly lifting the base dividend. A larger catalyst would be confirmation of higher cash flow from WCSB egress and NEBC Montney buildout translating into sustained buybacks or further dividend raises.
